title: P2RLN cmi5 Profile
description: Preserves cmi5 course packages and maps Course/Block/AU structure to P2RLN Course/Unit/Activity entities without replacing cmi5 launch or xAPI runtime semantics.
rules: cmi5.xml remains authoritative for AU launch rules and cmi5-specific runtime semantics.
cmi5 Course SHOULD map to the P2RLN Course identity when a stable absolute identifier is provided.
cmi5 Block SHOULD map to Unit and AU SHOULD map to Activity.
moveOn, masteryScore, launchMethod, launchParameters, entitlementKey and AU URL MUST be preserved when present.
Remote AU URLs MUST NOT be dereferenced during package validation.
